chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from Ali ibn Asbat, from Muhammad ibn al-Qasim ibn al-Fudayl, who said:

I said to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him): 'May I be sacrificed for you! Our camel-herd passed by with us and did not let us disembark at Al-Mu'arras.' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'It is necessary that you return to it.' So I returned to it.

key_terms.الْمُعَرَّس: The resting place or encampment of the Prophet (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What did the Imam say when the group missed the Prophet's resting place?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the spiritual significance of the Prophet’s resting place (*Al-Mu'arras*) in Shia tradition, where physical presence is linked to divine blessing. The Imam’s directive to return despite the delay underscores the principle of *tawassul* (seeking nearness to God) through sacred sites, a concept deeply rooted in Shia jurisprudence and spirituality. It reflects the belief that honoring the Prophet’s legacy extends to preserving and visiting locations associated with his life and journey.
